name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Long-serving incumbent Bobby Scott running for re-election
Republican challenger Edwin Rivera has raised only about $6,600
Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point overwhelmingly to Bobby Scott: an +18 Democratic district, incumbency, and a large fundraising gap over a barely funded challenger. Markets agree, pricing this near-certain for Democrats, so the forecast stays at a Safe D margin of about 24 points.
model.watch: A major outside-spending intervention for the Republican challenger or an unexpected Scott scandal could narrow the margin, though neither appears likely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bobby Scott, a longtime Democratic incumbent, is seeking re-election in a Hampton Roads-area district that leans Democratic by about 18 points. He has raised roughly $688,000 and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican nominee Edwin Rivera has raised only about $6,600 and reported minimal cash on hand. Two independent candidates are on the ballot but show little financial activity.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the fundraising gap, and prediction markets, which price a Scott win at about 95%. With no credible evidence of a competitive race, this sits firmly in Safe D territory.
